name: AzureScopedAccessToken
description: Exchanges a federated OIDC token for a Microsoft Entra access token for the requested resource.
author: Slawomir Koszewski

inputs.name: serviceConnection
inputs.label: Azure Resource Manager service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: AzureRM service connection used to request the OIDC token. Its app registration is the identity the access token is issued to, and it needs access to the requested resource. Requires System.AccessToken to be available to the job.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.label: Scope
inputs.helpMarkDown: Resource scope of the requested access token, for example https://graph.microsoft.com/.default, or 499b84ac-1321-427f-aa17-267ca6975798/.default for Azure DevOps. The client credentials flow issues application scopes, so the value ends with /.default.

inputs.name: accessTokenVariable
inputs.label: Access token variable name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the secret pipeline variable that receives the access token. The variable is secret, so later steps map it with `env:` under whatever name the tool expects. The name may contain letters, digits, `.` and `_`, and must not start with the Azure DevOps reserved prefixes endpoint, input, secret, path or securefile.

inputs.name: printTokenHashes
inputs.label: Print SHA256 token hashes to logs
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, prints the SHA256 hash of the issued access token.
